milestone1.title: 情境選句(章 1-4 — 開頭 / 通知 / 請求)

questions.prompt: 你寫信給不熟的窗口要詢問價格,最佳開頭?
options: To whom it may concern, prices please.
Dear [Name], I am writing to inquire about your pricing.
questions.explanationZh: 正式詢問用 Dear [Name] + I am writing to inquire about。Hey / To whom it may concern 都是雷區。

questions.prompt: 你想委婉催客戶 3 天內回覆,選句?
options: I would appreciate it if you could respond by Friday.
questions.explanationZh: I would appreciate it if you could 是英文軟催魔法句;客戶 / 老闆讀了不反感。ASAP / should / immediately 都太硬。

questions.prompt: 你想通知客戶系統會延遲上線,最佳開場?
options: Please be advised that there will be a delay in the launch.
System won't be ready. Deal with it.
questions.explanationZh: Please be advised 是商務專用,既嚴肅又不慌張。比 sorry 早一步、比 inform 高一階。

questions.prompt: 對方寄信後 3 天才回信,合適的道歉?
options: It was your fault for emailing late.
questions.explanationZh: Apologies for the delayed response 是 24 小時內沒回信的標配開場,正式又禮貌。

questions.prompt: 你想客氣請對方提供業務資料?
options: Could you provide me with the latest sales figures?
questions.explanationZh: provide me with 比 give me 正式;合約 / 業務資料都用 provide。

questions.prompt: 提醒客戶 deadline 將至,最佳句型?
options: This is a friendly reminder that the submission deadline is approaching.
questions.explanationZh: friendly reminder = 催但不兇,英文 Email 高頻片語。

questions.prompt: 通知人事異動「下月起 Mary 接手客服」?
options: Mary takes over from next month.
As of next month, Mary will be taking over customer service.
Mary is the new customer service.
questions.explanationZh: As of [date] ... will be taking over [role] 是正式人事公告句型。

questions.prompt: 你不確定對方是否能幫忙,最委婉的請求?
options: Would it be possible to extend the deadline by one week?
You need to extend the deadline.
questions.explanationZh: Would it be possible to 隱含「我知道可能麻煩」,適合請對方額外付出 / 對上級用。

questions.prompt: 「我希望這封信你收到時一切都好」對應哪句?
options: I hope this email finds you well.
questions.explanationZh: I hope this email finds you well 是模板級高頻開頭,跨文化通用,歐美客戶特別愛。

questions.prompt: 「at your earliest convenience」的真實含義?
questions.explanationZh: at your earliest convenience 是商務套路:看似客氣,實際是「盡早」。對方一般 1-2 天內會回。

questions.prompt: 「inquire」跟「ask」哪個更適合商務?
questions.explanationZh: inquire 較正式,商務書面適合;ask 偏口語 / 隨意。

questions.prompt: 客戶 Email 第一句結束,要請求服務 — 哪個轉折最自然?
options: I would appreciate it if you could ...
questions.explanationZh: I would appreciate it if you could ... 是英文 Email 從問候平滑接到請求最常用的轉折。

questions.prompt: 最常用的商務 Email 結尾?
questions.explanationZh: Best regards 是最通用;Sincerely 偏履歷 / 求職用,XOXO 跟 Love 是私人信。

questions.prompt: 「沒事不用回,有問題再找我」最佳句型?
options: Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.
questions.explanationZh: Please do not hesitate to reach out 是模板級客戶服務句。

questions.prompt: 你想開會,最有效率的問法?
options: Are you available on Monday at 2pm or Tuesday at 10am?
questions.explanationZh: 永遠提供 2-3 個具體時段,別問開放式「什麼時候有空」(對方要花腦力選)。

questions.prompt: 「附議程與預習資料」?
options: Please find the agenda and pre-read materials attached.
questions.explanationZh: Please find ... attached 是商務 Email 附件標準句。pre-read materials = 預習資料。

questions.prompt: 重大失誤後,合適的開頭道歉?
options: I would like to sincerely apologize for the error in last week's report.
questions.explanationZh: sincerely apologize 用於重大失誤,加重份量。小事用 sincerely 反而顯反諷。

questions.prompt: 解釋原因不找藉口,合適結構?
options: The issue was caused by [reason], and we are taking steps to prevent it from happening again.
I don't know why it happened.
questions.explanationZh: 解釋 + 改善動作的標準結構。「we are taking steps」表示已經在動,比 we will 強。

questions.prompt: 「我已把 Tom 加進這封信的 cc」?
options: I cc'd Tom on this email.
questions.explanationZh: cc'd = cc 的過去式,讀作 cee-cee-d。商務 Email 通用寫法。

questions.prompt: 「根據您上封信」最簡潔的引用?
questions.explanationZh: As per 是商務 Email 引用慣用語,比 According to 簡潔書面。

questions.prompt: 想要先謝對方協助,放在信尾合適嗎?
options: Thank you in advance for your assistance.
questions.explanationZh: Thank you in advance for your assistance 是委託 / 請求類 Email 必備收尾。

questions.prompt: 「請確認收到這封信」?
options: Could you confirm receipt of this email?
questions.explanationZh: confirm receipt 是商務固定片語,比 did you get this 正式。

questions.prompt: 「不急,你方便時告訴我」?
options: No rush — let me know when you have a moment.
questions.explanationZh: No rush 是英文 Email「讓對方放心」收尾;配請求句一起用很萬用。

questions.prompt: 客戶服務道歉信收尾,最佳句?
options: Thank you for your patience and understanding.
questions.explanationZh: Thank you for your patience and understanding 是道歉信標配結尾,讓客戶氣消一半。

questions.prompt: 「我必須改期」最建設性的說法?
options: Unfortunately, I need to reschedule our meeting due to a conflict.
questions.explanationZh: reschedule 比 cancel 建設性;Unfortunately + due to [reason] = 帶歉意 + 解釋原因。

questions.prompt: 「這事有時效性」最得體的說法?
options: This is time-sensitive — could you respond by Friday?
questions.explanationZh: time-sensitive 比 urgent 軟,給對方尊重;搭配明確截止日效果最好。

questions.prompt: 客戶問你問題你還沒答,3 天後追蹤,合適開場?
options: Following up on my previous email regarding the proposal.
questions.explanationZh: Following up on my previous email regarding [topic] 是商務 Email 第二高頻片語,客氣有效。
